description: This file defines the SNProtocolOperator001 class, a legacy encryption operator for generating and managing encryption keys, encrypting/decrypting data, and handling related cryptographic operations within the Standard Notes project.

classes.name: SNProtocolOperator001
classes.description: A legacy encryption operator class used for generating keys, encrypting, and decrypting data, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: getEncryptionDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the encryption method, 'AES-256'.

methods.name: createItemsKey
methods.description: Creates a new items encryption key.

methods.name: createRootKey
methods.description: Generates a new root key based on identifier, password, and origination.

methods.name: getPayloadAuthenticatedData
methods.description: Returns authenticated data for a given encrypted payload, currently always undefined.

methods.name: computeRootKey
methods.description: Derives a root key from a password and key parameters.

methods.name: generateEncryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Encrypts a payload with a given key, producing encrypted parameters.

methods.name: generateDecryptedParametersAsync
methods.description: Decrypts encrypted parameters to retrieve the original payload content.

methods.name: encryptionComponentsFromString
methods.description: Extracts ciphertext, version, and key from an encrypted string.

methods.name: deriveKey
methods.description: Derives a key using PBKDF2 with specified parameters.
